Title: Generally Available: Azure Monitor Logs now supports Availability Zones in Canada Central, France Central and Japan East

Body.Content:
Azure Monitor Logs continues to extend its Availability Zone support by adding three regions – Canada Central, France Central and Japan East – to the East US 2 and West US 2 regions, which are already supported.

Azure Availability Zones (AZ) provide protection from datacenter failures by using in-region redundancy between datacenters in separate zones, each with its own independent infrastructure.

Availability Zone support in Canada Central, France Central and Japan East makes the service processes in these regions more resilient to datacenter outages. To ensure you also keep your data safe and available in the face of a datacenter outage, link your workspace to a dedicated cluster that uses Availability Zones (now enabled by default in regions that support AZ).

For more information see Availability zones in Azure Monitor.
